newsitem.title: FRANCE: M6 says 1996 results depend on advertising market.
newsitem.headline: M6 says 1996 results depend on advertising market.

text.p: French television channel M6 said in a statement on Thursday its 1996 results "will depend largely on the state of the advertising market during the next three months".

M6 also said its investment in TPS, a joint venture to set up digital satellite television in France, would not affect the group's 1996 full year profit that much. M6 holds 20 percent of the capital of TPS (Television par Satellite).
M6 announced earlier on Thursday a 2.3 percent increase in net consolidated profit to 215 million francs in the six months to June 30, 1996.
